name: ENUBET
full_name: Enhanced NeUtrino BEams from kaon Tagging
summary: ENUBET is a monitored-neutrino-beam research programme that developed an instrumented decay-tunnel demonstrator. Its demonstrated hardware and the later nuSCOPE facility proposal are recorded separately.
detection_principle: Sampling calorimeters and fast photon-veto layers identify positrons and other charged leptons from meson decay in the tunnel. Counting these particles constrains the associated neutrino flux without relying only on hadron-production simulations.

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: The dated 2026 paper reports demonstrator performance from 2022-2024 tests.

key_parameters.name: Technology
key_parameters.value: Iron-scintillator longitudinal sampling calorimeter, wavelength-shifting fibres and SiPMs

key_parameters.name: Beam tests
key_parameters.value: Electrons, muons and pions up to 5 GeV in the reported campaigns

results.summary: Demonstrated scalable instrumentation and particle-identification performance meeting the monitored-beam design requirements; this is a charged-particle prototype result, not a completed neutrino cross-section exposure.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
